Grain and identity: One immutable acquired byte object, asset_id
Key fields: source URL/version; sha256; media type; size; retrieval time; rights state
Invariant or index: Hash identifies bytes, not permission to use them. Namespace and release state remain separate.

Key fields: manifest hash; source sections; applicability; reviewer; activation/retirement
Invariant or index: Only active approved release used for rule/retrieval evaluation; previous revisions retained.

Grain and identity: One exact source section in a release
Key fields: source_asset_id; locator; text hash; requirement code; population/mission applicability
Invariant or index: Unique (release_id, source_asset_id, locator). Full source text stays traceable.

Grain and identity: One research cohort or simulated/operational namespace
Key fields: namespace type; study/mission id; permitted purpose
Invariant or index: A research subject cannot become a crew member by changing a display name.

Key fields: subject_id; namespace_id; external source identifier
Invariant or index: Unique (namespace_id, external_identifier). No cross-study joins without an authorized linkage.

Grain and identity: One subject role assignment for a mission interval
Key fields: subject_id; mission_id; role; start/end; qualification context
Invariant or index: Role assignment is not a clinical credential. Mission context is explicit.

Grain and identity: One authorization relationship and purpose scope
Key fields: actor; subject; mission; purpose; fields/actions; validity interval; policy revision
Invariant or index: Check at every read/write/export; revocation applies before packet release.

Grain and identity: One acquisition session and clock segment
Key fields: device/firmware; adapter version; channel capabilities; clock basis; reset segment
Invariant or index: Index device/session/segment. Reboot starts new segment; receipt time does not replace sample time.

Key fields: subject; specimen kind; site; collection interval; assay context
Invariant or index: Comparison requires compatible specimen/method; avoid fictitious fields for non-lab modalities.

Key fields: quantity kind; canonical unit; value type; permitted dimensions; reference context
Invariant or index: Interbeat RR and respiratory RR are distinct quantities even if source labels match.

Grain and identity: One reviewed mapping from a source field
Key fields: source/schema version; raw field/unit; quantity; transform; reviewer; mapping version
Invariant or index: Unknown/mismatched mapping quarantines interpretation. No silent percent-to-g/dL assumption.

Grain and identity: One submitted source packet/file and processing run
Key fields: idempotency key; source hash; schema/adapter; expected count; per-outcome counts
Invariant or index: Account for accepted, quarantined, duplicate and rejected records; partial status is explicit.

Key fields: observation_id; revision_id; subject; quantity; raw value/unit; canonical value; state; method; source locator; time
Invariant or index: Append revision. Indexed subject/quantity/time basis. Current pointer changes with audit and dependency invalidation.

Grain and identity: One original event interval and clock mapping
Key fields: raw label; time basis; segment; optional UTC bounds; precision; uncertainty; receipt time
Invariant or index: L-/R+ labels remain relative. Wire nanoseconds use decimal strings to avoid JavaScript precision loss.

Grain and identity: One verified file or derived chunk
Key fields: asset_id; internal storage key; hash; schema; encryption/key reference; retention class
Invariant or index: Internal keys never come from uploaded paths. Registry marks ready only after verified file publication.

Grain and identity: One channel in a signal object
Key fields: sample encoding; rate or irregular-time basis; calibration; physical unit; channel/site
Invariant or index: Do not flatten annotations or images into scalar vitals. Preserve original EDF separately.

Key fields: algorithm/version; parameters; mapping/release; exact input revision IDs; outputs
Invariant or index: Content-addressed inputs and named algorithm enable re-evaluation; no claim of bitwise cross-platform equality.

Grain and identity: One evaluated result or applicability failure
Key fields: subject; quantity/domain; result; reason; quality; missing context; derivation ID
Invariant or index: Separate collection fault from possible physiological change; no invented global health score.

Key fields: subject; attention reason; state; next actor; selected findings; resume state
Invariant or index: Stable ID and version; transitions enforced by backend, not chat messages.

Key fields: episode; action kind; procedure version; actor; authority; evidence basis; outcome
Invariant or index: An AI draft cannot set authorized or complete. Named human action and permissions required.

Key fields: episode/action; responsible role; due time or event; state; result link
Invariant or index: No unresolved action disappears after packet transmission.

Key fields: subject/purpose; destination; payload hash; exact revisions; release actor/time; supersedes
Invariant or index: Any content change creates new packet/reapproval. Prior delivered versions remain historical.

Key fields: packet_id; destination; attempt; next retry; transport result; receiver receipt
Invariant or index: At-least-once delivery with receiver deduplication. Transport success is not clinical review.

Key fields: kind; input refs; state; lease/expiry; attempts; cancellation; result refs
Invariant or index: Reclaim expired leases safely. Retry only idempotent operations. Do not keep a DB transaction open during inference.

Key fields: actor; action; object/revision; purpose; time; correlation; policy release
Invariant or index: Append with the domain transaction. Local history alone is not tamper-proof against administrator compromise.

Key fields: model artifact hash; runtime build; prompt/template; retrieval inputs; parameters; validation; duration
Invariant or index: Draft/version retained under retention policy; no raw prompt or clinical text in generic logs.
